summary: Diageo plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for July 2026, containing routine UK regulatory announcements: total voting rights as of 30 June 2026 (2,226,584,768 voting rights; 2,432,397,125 issued shares, 205,812,357 in treasury) and Director/PDMR shareholding notifications under UK MAR. The Chair received shares via dividend reinvestment and made a purchase; no prices beyond £15.29 for DRIP shares. A minor correction of 28,355 null-and-void shares from the 1997 Guinness/Grand Met merger was noted. No special-situation event occurred; this is routine ongoing disclosure for a foreign private issuer.
